- If the candidate at the top of the merit list does not report or accept the appointment, the next candidate can be offered the post according to DoPT OM No. 41019/18/97-Estt(B) dated 13.06.2000.

- DoPT OM No. 14017/18/2004-Estt.(RR) dated 29.03.2004
- DoPT OM No. 41019/18/97-Estt(B) dated 13.06.2000

These OMs provide the framework for what happens if the top candidate does not accept the offer, ensuring that the next eligible candidate can be considered and offered the position.

1. The FD-III section should make necessary changes in the draft sanction order to make it valid for the financial year 2018-19 instead of 2017-18.
2. After making these changes, the FD-III section should allot a new FD diary number for the current financial year.
3. The file is then to be returned to the concerned grants sanctioning bureau for issuance of the final sanction order and preparation of grants-in-aid bill as per usual procedure.

This process differs from cases pending in grant sanctioning bureaus for obtaining competent authority sanction (category E) because, in those cases, a new draft sanction order needs to be prepared by the grant sanctioning bureaus for the financial year 2018-19 without seeking revised sanction of the competent authority.
reference: For cases where draft sanction orders were approved by FD-III but final sanction orders were not issued by 31.03.2018, FD-III must return the draft sanction order to the grants sanctioning bureau after changing the year to 2018-19 and allotting a new diary number. The grants sanctioning bureau then issues a fresh sanction order cancelling the earlier one and submits it with the bill to Finance Division for payment. In contrast, for cases pending in grant sanctioning bureaus for obtaining competent authority sanction, the sanction for the financial year 2018-19 must be obtained first, and then the sanction order issued and payment made as per usual procedure.
